n1.speaker: vance
n1.tellCaption: Stage lights are dimmed to amber as Julian Vance gazes up at the bronze Armillary Orrery.
n1.text: Magnificent, isn't it? Three centuries of celestial mechanics—and human vanity still thinks it owns the stars.

choices.label: "Nadia found the initials 'A.M. — 2019' scratched inside that bronze ring."
"You sound like a host who has outgrown his own sponsors, Julian."

passiveDomainCheck.insight: Greenwich's 1884 meridian vote succeeded only because maritime charts opened freely to all ships.

n2_a.speaker: vance
n2_a.tellCaption: His fingers freeze on his left brass cufflink.
n2_a.text: Did she. Tariq always had an engineer's habit of signing every instrument he calibrated.

n2_b.speaker: vance
n2_b.tellCaption: He taps his silver stylus once against the marble rail.
n2_b.text: Sponsors build stages to flatter themselves. Occasionally the stage outlives them.

n3.speaker: vance
n3.tellCaption: Rain patters softly high above on the glass oculus.
n3.text: Promise me one thing: when Cairo opens its doors, read the whole ledger before you judge the author.

choices.label: "Show me clean evidence in Cairo, and you will get a fair verdict."
"My loyalty belongs to the truth—and to Tariq's sister."

n4_close.speaker: vance
n4_close.tellCaption: Vance steps back into the Rotunda shadows with a quiet bow.
n4_close.text: That is the exact answer Tariq gave me seven years ago. Sleep well, Challenger.

n1.speaker: soren
n1.tellCaption: A 24K gold-rimmed coin dances effortlessly across Soren's knuckles against neon rain.
n1.text: Nice view from the seventy-second floor, right? Down there is Shibuya—up here, information is currency.

n2.speaker: teo
n2.tellCaption: Teo holds up a live packet-analyzer spike beside the kumiko screen.
n2.text: Look at this packet trace—Soren's locking answers in zero-point-eight seconds. Faster than human optic nerve latency!

passiveDomainCheck.insight: Sub-vocal bone-conduction transceivers bypass eardrums completely—only a wideband jammer kills them.

n3.speaker: soren
n3.tellCaption: Soren's coin freezes dead flat between two fingers as his amber smart-lenses glint.
n3.text: Caught my Horizon earpiece, did you? Name your price: share my probability lens, or trigger a live jammer and fly blind with me.

choices.label: Share the Probability Feed (-Integrity, Unlocks Horizon Lens)
Fire the Live Signal Jammer (+Integrity, Triggers Twist Fracture!)

n4_blackmail.speaker: soren
n4_blackmail.tellCaption: He flicks the coin into the air and winks.
n4_blackmail.text: Smart business. Keep my secret, and my odds overlay is yours for the rest of the circuit.

n4_jammer.speaker: soren
n4_jammer.tellCaption: Crimson emergency strobes ignite across the rain glass—Soren actually grins.
n4_jammer.text: You actually fired the jammer live?! Crimson lights, sealed shutters—alright, let's see raw instinct!

n5_fracture.speaker: vance
n5_fracture.tellCaption: Julian Vance's voice booms across the pavilion PA as shutters slam shut.
n5_fracture.text: Signal anomaly detected in Sector Seven. Peeling shutters locked—we are live in Twist Fracture.

n1.speaker: soren
n1.tellCaption: Soren sets his dead bone-conduction wafer on the black urushi lacquer table.
n1.text: No feed, no odds, just pure nerve—and you still beat me. Listen: whoever bankrolled my feed answers to Cairo.

n2.speaker: teo
n2.tellCaption: Teo traces a glowing geodesic arc from Tokyo straight into Northern Africa.
n2.text: Soren's encrypted relay bounces straight through a dormant diplomatic node beneath the Cairo Citadel.

choices.label: Toss Soren's coin back—"Stay alive. We may need a card shark later."
Lock the Horizon wafer inside your diplomatic pouch as hard evidence

n1.speaker: nadia
n1.tellCaption: Nadia presses a pocket accelerometer against the seventy-second-floor window frame.
n1.text: Feel that hum? Bullet trains pass seventy stories down, yet not a single teacup ripples up here.

choices.label: "Could someone hide a data carrier inside that damper frequency?"
"Pure structural elegance—engineering turned into quiet art."

passiveDomainCheck.insight: Active piezo-dampers inject an inverted 62 Hz acoustic wave across the pavilion glass.

n2_a.speaker: nadia
n2_a.tellCaption: Her eyes widen at the accelerometer readout.
n2_a.text: Sharp catch! Look—there is a narrowband phase modulation riding right on top of sixty-two hertz!

n2_b.speaker: nadia
n2_b.tellCaption: She smiles, then frowns at a secondary harmonic spike.
n2_b.text: Wait—the glass is singing two notes at once. One cancels train noise, and one carries encrypted packets!

n3.speaker: teo
n3.tellCaption: Teo slides up with his handheld spectrum scope.
n3.text: Bingo! That phase modulation points straight toward Soren's podium collar.

choices.label: Keep the discovery quiet so you can catch Horizon red-handed in M3
Log an anonymous calibration ticket with Vance's stage marshals

n4_close.speaker: nadia
n4_close.tellCaption: Nadia pockets her sensor with fierce satisfaction.
n4_close.text: Let Horizon bring all the silicon they want—physics never lies.

n1.speaker: lindqvist
n1.tellCaption: Neon skyline rain shimmers behind Chancellor Lindqvist's silver silhouette.
n1.text: Now you see Horizon Collective without its press gloss. Speed worshipped without ethical brakes.

choices.label: "Horizon cheats with speed; Sovereign cheats with redactions. Pick your poison."
"What exactly does Director Takahashi want from The Ledger?"

passiveDomainCheck.insight: Sub-second algorithmic previews can drain public pension markets before regulators blink.

n2_a.speaker: lindqvist
n2_a.tellCaption: Her gaze hardens to cold Baltic granite.
n2_a.text: Clever wit does not keep power grids online during winter crises, Challenger.

n2_b.speaker: lindqvist
n2_b.tellCaption: She slides a financial brief across the hinoki wood table.
n2_b.text: Four hundred milliseconds of advance warning on global energy shortages. Worth fourteen billion dollars every quarter.

n3.speaker: lindqvist
n3.tellCaption: She rises smoothly as the stage chime sounds.
n3.text: Remember that figure when Horizon's apologists preach open velocity.

choices.label: Take the arbitrage dossier to cross-check against Soren's coin
Leave her folder on the table—refuse Sovereign spin

n4_close.speaker: teo
n4_close.tellCaption: In the corridor outside, Teo whispers low.
n4_close.text: Every faction loves exposing the other two—just save every page they drop!

n1.speaker: nadia
n1.tellCaption: Blue voltage arcs spit across Nadia's brass gimbal as 10,000 spectators gasp.
n1.text: My Prism clamps are surging—someone spiked my pod's voltage! If I let go now, my shield shatters!

choices.label: Sacrifice 1 Prism Shield to Ground Nadia's Pod (ALLIED Nadia + Co-Op Perk)
Protect Your Shields & Claim the #1 Seed (NEMESIS Nadia)

n2_saved.speaker: nadia
n2_saved.tellCaption: Smoke clears; Nadia's eyes lock onto yours with fierce, unshakeable loyalty.
n2_saved.text: You burned your own Prism Shield to stabilize my pod... I won't forget this. From here to the Apex, we're allies.

n2_nemesis.speaker: nadia
n2_nemesis.tellCaption: Her burned glove wrenches the manual breaker shut—her stare could cut diamond.
n2_nemesis.text: You watched my pod burn just to take the number-one seed. Fine—from now on, I target your weakest domain every match.

n1.speaker: teo
n1.tellCaption: Teo pries a scorched relay out of Nadia's pedestal with insulated pliers.
n1.text: That voltage spike didn't come from the arena—it was triggered with a Council override key.

choices.label: Send the scorched relay serial ahead to Nadia's Cairo team
Seal the relay in foil until you reach The Ledger's core servers

passiveDomainCheck.insight: Only three individuals hold root override keys: Lindqvist, Takahashi, and Okafor.

n1.speaker: soren
n1.tellCaption: Soren holds up the scorched relay pulled from Nadia's sabotaged pod—zero smirk today.
n1.text: Nadia thinks my sponsors fried her clamps. Look at the lot serial laser-etched under the soot.

choices.label: "Show me the batch routing—I judge proof, not logos."
"After Tokyo's earpiece, can you blame anyone for suspecting Horizon?"

passiveDomainCheck.insight: Export batch CH-8841 left Osaka for customs bonded storage in Zurich, never Brazil.

n2_a.speaker: soren
n2_a.tellCaption: Relief flickers behind his amber lenses.
n2_a.text: Batch 8841 shipped to a Zurich diplomatic shell three weeks ago—paid in Swiss francs.

n2_b.speaker: soren
n2_b.tellCaption: He takes the hit squarely on the chin.
n2_b.text: Fair shot. An earpiece is poker hustle—240 volts on Nadia's hands could have hospitalized her. Not my game.

n3.speaker: nadia
n3.tellCaption: Nadia steps out from behind the giant palm fronds, having heard every word.
n3.text: Zurich shell 8841... the exact clearing code Soren warned us shorted my bracket in London.

choices.label: Broker a truce between Nadia and Soren against Lindqvist's operative
Send Teo to pull the Rio port import signature immediately

n4_close.speaker: nadia
n4_close.tellCaption: Nadia extends a bandaged hand to Soren—and he shakes it firmly.
n4_close.text: Truce, card shark. Help us nail whoever wired my pod.

n1.speaker: vance
n1.tellCaption: Lanterns glow through rainforest mist as Julian Vance stamps a gold envoy seal onto your folder.
n1.text: Welcome to the midpoint of The Meridian. Your Act II Diplomatic Cross-Clearance is now active across all prior capitals.

choices.label: "Good—no stone in London or Tokyo stays unturned."
"You built Rio's acoustics to match Giza, Julian. What is buried in Cairo?"

passiveDomainCheck.insight: Cross-clearance grants sovereign courier immunity across Geneva, London, Tokyo, and Rio.

n2_a.speaker: vance
n2_a.tellCaption: He closes the brass inkpad with horological neatness.
n2_a.text: Thoroughness is the mark of a true polymath. Every city dossier remains open to your review.

n2_b.speaker: vance
n2_b.tellCaption: For the last time before Egypt, his fingers graze his left cufflink.
n2_b.text: Thirty-eight meters below Cairo's Solar Hall lies the reason I stayed in this job for seven years.

n3.speaker: vance
n3.tellCaption: Distant thunder rumbles beyond Corcovado.
n3.text: When the lights go out in Giza tomorrow, follow Nadia's acoustic math—not the security marshals.

choices.label: "Whatever happened in 2019, it comes into the light."
Give Vance a subtle nod—message received loud and clear

n4_close.speaker: teo
n4_close.tellCaption: Teo watches Vance walk down the glass stair.
n4_close.text: Did Julian Vance basically just hand us keys to rob his own basement in Cairo?!

n1.speaker: teo
n1.tellCaption: Dusty amber monitors bloom awake across thirty-eight meters of carved limestone.
n1.text: Stop everything. Look at Julian Vance's private psychometric ledger: ninety-nine-point-four percent cognitive match.

n2.speaker: nadia
n2.tellCaption: Nadia presses trembling fingers to the 2019 winner portrait beside your own chart.
n2.text: Tariq Al-Mansoor... my brother won Trial Zero seven years ago—and refused to hand the Ledger veto key to Lindqvist.

n3.speaker: vance
n3.tellCaption: Julian Vance's holographic projection flickers from the central plinth—cufflink glinting.
n3.text: I didn't recruit you by chance. Yours was the only mind on Earth capable of finishing what Tariq began.

choices.label: Download the 99.4% Ledger Dossier & confront the Great Fork
Inspect Vance's cipher footer first (Uncovers Rescue Stamp Clue!)

n1.speaker: teo
n1.tellCaption: Security boots thunder overhead; Teo's finger hovers over the live global uplink switch.
n1.text: Look at the date on Trial Zero. Two thousand nineteen. That winner was Nadia's brother—and Vance matched your mind to his.

choices.label: Transmit Dossier Live to 2B Viewers (WHISTLEBLOWER + People's Lens)
Seal the Dossier & Infiltrate the Conclave (INSIDER + Council Override)

n2_whistle.speaker: teo
n2_whistle.tellCaption: Every broadcast monitor across six continents flashes crimson with Trial Zero.
n2_whistle.text: Broadcasting the Cairo files live! Two billion people just saw the Trial Zero cover-up!

n2_insider.speaker: vance
n2_insider.tellCaption: On a private encrypted band, Julian Vance taps his stylus once.
n2_insider.text: Hold the files close. Play the Council from the inside, and we take their entire board apart.

n1.speaker: nadia
n1.tellCaption: Under amber vault lamps, Nadia holds Tariq's 2019 champion photograph beside your Geneva file.
n1.text: Look at the two response curves overlaid on acetate. Ninety-nine-point-four percent identical.

choices.label: "Nobody replaces your brother, Nadia. I am here to finish his fight—with you."
"What is the 0.6% where Tariq and I diverge?"

passiveDomainCheck.insight: Matching lateral hesitation curves across twelve domains occurs roughly once in four hundred thousand minds.

n2_a.speaker: nadia
n2_a.tellCaption: She wipes a tear quickly with the back of her wrist and smiles.
n2_a.text: Tariq always hated solo heroes anyway. He believed in ensembles.

n2_b.speaker: nadia
n2_b.tellCaption: She points to the corner of Julian's chart.
n2_b.text: Tariq played pure idealism on every turn. Julian wrote that your 0.6% edge is street-level adaptability.

n3.speaker: teo
n3.tellCaption: Teo holds up Julian's wax extraction stamp under a magnifier.
n3.text: And look—Flight 00-North departed Geneva at 04:18 UTC toward Keflavik, Iceland!

choices.label: "Keflavik! Nadia—Julian smuggled him north, he didn't bury him!"
"Verify the tail number in Reykjavik before we celebrate."

n4_close.speaker: nadia
n4_close.tellCaption: Nadia clutches the Keflavik slip like oxygen.
n4_close.text: Pack everything. Nothing on Earth stops me from reaching Iceland.

n1.speaker: soren
n1.tellCaption: Desert wind whips sand across floodlit steps as Soren blocks two Sovereign marshals with press cameras.
n1.text: Evening, Chancellor! Surely you are not sealing an ancient monument while live broadcast vans are rolling?

choices.label: Step smoothly beside Soren in front of the live Egyptian press lens
Draw Lindqvist aside to buy Teo sixty extra seconds underground

passiveDomainCheck.insight: Public broadcast cameras trigger diplomatic immunity clauses under host-country agreements.

n2_a.speaker: lindqvist
n2_a.tellCaption: Chancellor Lindqvist stops on the top limestone step, eyes flashing cold.
n2_a.text: Cheap theatrics will not shield unauthorized subterranean tampering, Mr. Kael.

n2_b.speaker: lindqvist
n2_b.tellCaption: She lowers her voice out of microphone range.
n2_b.text: You stand on dangerous ground, Challenger. Trial Zero was sealed to prevent a three-bloc fracture.

n3.speaker: soren
n3.tellCaption: In your ear, Teo clicks twice—the Giza drive is safely out the side gate.
n3.text: All clear on my end—give the Chancellor a gracious goodnight!

choices.label: "See you in the semi-finals, Chancellor. Bring sharper marshals."
"Goodnight, Madam Chair. Safe flight north."

n4_close.speaker: soren
n4_close.tellCaption: Once the sedans pull away, Soren exhales with a grin.
n4_close.text: Remind me never to play poker against that woman without live television.

n1.speaker: tariq
n1.tellCaption: Emerald aurora light spills across hexagonal basalt as a living ghost steps from the steam.
n1.text: Step into the light. Yes—it's really me. Seven winters beneath the basalt caldera, waiting for a mind like yours.

n2.speaker: tariq
n2.tellCaption: Tariq traces a quiet brass triangle linking Geneva, Cairo, and the Apex Forum.
n2.text: Julian staged my disappearance when Lindqvist ordered me silenced. Together, we built this Championship as a Trojan Horse.

n3.speaker: vance
n3.tellCaption: Julian Vance joins over the geothermal relay—zero cufflink tells left, total candor.
n3.text: Once two billion viewers crown you live at the Apex Forum, not even the World Council can erase the keyholder.

choices.label: Join Tariq & Vance's Trojan Gambit (+Integrity, Vault Clue #3)
"No more handlers. I take the Master Key on my own terms."

n1.speaker: lindqvist
n1.tellCaption: Chancellor Lindqvist's voice slices across the caldera speakers as perimeter alarms wail.
n1.text: Geothermal array located. Enjoy your reunion while it lasts—Singapore will separate pretenders from rulers.

n2.speaker: tariq
n2.tellCaption: Tariq presses a cold basalt cipher cylinder firmly into your palm.
n2.text: Take my Cryo-Core cipher. Whatever happens in Singapore, do not let Lindqvist seize the Master Ledger.

choices.label: Ensure Tariq evacuates safely with Nadia's team before takeoff
Upload the Cryo-Core cipher and scramble immediately for Marina Bay

n1.speaker: nadia
n1.tellCaption: Beside glowing geothermal pipes, Nadia punches Tariq's shoulder—then pulls him into a fierce embrace.
n1.text: Seven years, Tariq! One postcard—one single acoustic cipher earlier—would that have killed you?!

choices.label: "Sovereign tapped your London fellowship, Nadia—one letter would have endangered you."
"She crossed four continents hunting your ghost, Tariq. She earned the truth sooner."

passiveDomainCheck.insight: Any contact with family prior to Act III would have painted a Sovereign target on Nadia.

n2_a.speaker: tariq
n2_a.tellCaption: Tariq bows his head, eyes bright with emotion.
n2_a.text: Lindqvist watched your Bloomsbury lab day and night. Keeping quiet was the hardest math I ever did.

n2_b.speaker: tariq
n2_b.tellCaption: He holds his sister's hands tightly.
n2_b.text: You are right. Julian and I treated everything like a chessboard—and forgot how much waiting hurts.

n3.speaker: nadia
n3.tellCaption: Nadia dries her cheek and turns toward you both.
n3.text: No more ghosts and no more solo sacrifices. From Iceland to the ocean, nobody gets left behind.

choices.label: Swear an unbreakable pact between Nadia, Tariq, Teo, and yourself
Turn immediately to mapping Lindqvist's next move in Marina Bay

n4_close.speaker: tariq
n4_close.tellCaption: Tariq smiles—for the first time looking every inch Nadia's brother.
n4_close.text: Now let us go finish what Pod One started.

n1.speaker: teo
n1.tellCaption: Green aurora dances across snowdrifts as Teo bolts a wideband feedhorn onto the caldera dish.
n1.text: Two billion viewers at the Apex mean nothing if Lindqvist's navy cuts the Atlantic fiber trunk.

choices.label: Calculate the polar ionospheric skip angles alongside Teo
Use Soren's old Horizon relay codes to lock Pacific mirror dishes

passiveDomainCheck.insight: High-frequency skywave reflects cleanly off ionized auroral E-layers across continental distances.

n2_a.speaker: teo
n2_a.tellCaption: Signal-to-noise climbs into crisp emerald green across all six bands.
n2_a.text: Locked! Reykjavik to Montreal, London, and Nairobi in three clean hops!

n2_b.speaker: soren
n2_b.tellCaption: Soren punches an old Osaka maintenance override into the console.
n2_b.text: Surprise, Director Takahashi—Horizon's own Tokyo dish just became a free-speech mirror!

n3.speaker: tariq
n3.tellCaption: Tariq hands warm thermoses of cardamom coffee around the snowy parapet.
n3.text: When Lindqvist slams her emergency cutoff at the Apex, every screen on Earth will stay lit.

choices.label: Raise a steaming cup to the rogue crew behind the curtain
Test triple-redundant failover before packing for Singapore

n4_close.speaker: soren
n4_close.tellCaption: Soren grins into the Arctic wind.
n4_close.text: Freezing my fingers off for global democracy. Wait till Macau hears about this.

n1.speaker: lindqvist
n1.tellCaption: Ultraviolet security beams lock both ends of the suspended glass skybridge.
n1.text: Did you truly believe every ally in your corner was immune to price? Step forward and show them.

choices.label: Confront Nadia (If Rio Pod Was Abandoned)
Confront Teo (If Integrity Dropped Below -15)
Confront Interim Contender Soren

n2_nadia.speaker: nadia
n2_nadia.tellCaption: Nadia holds a Sovereign amnesty decree bearing Tariq's name—jaw trembling.
n2_nadia.text: Lindqvist promised me Tariq's freedom if I stop you tonight. Forgive me—family comes first.

n2_teo.speaker: teo
n2_teo.tellCaption: Teo's eyes dart frantically toward two armed Sovereign marshals at the glass lift.
n2_teo.text: They threatened my family in Geneva... I'm sorry! Solve the seal fast before my lockout finishes!

n2_soren.speaker: soren
n2_soren.tellCaption: Soren holds his coin dead still—offering you a subtle fighter's nod behind Lindqvist's back.
n2_soren.text: Nothing personal, friend—the Council cleared my syndicate slate. Beat me clean, and I'll still hand you the override.

backstage_conversations.title: After the Lockout: Mercy or Steel

n1.speaker: tariq
n1.tellCaption: Tariq's encrypted voice cuts through the lift intercom as Marina Bay drops away below.
n1.text: Vance didn't imprison me. He hid me—so you could carry the truth live before two billion witnesses.

choices.label: Pardon the coerced ally—turn Lindqvist's leverage to dust (+18 Integrity)
Strip their access credentials and board the Apex helicopter alone

backstage_conversations.title: Two Architects on an Encrypted Line

n1.speaker: tariq
n1.tellCaption: Monsoon rain lashes ninety-story glass as Tariq and Julian Vance connect through your handheld terminal.
n1.text: Seven years since Geneva Hangar Four, Julian. Lindqvist just invoked Article IX on the bridge.

choices.label: "Did you foresee Lindqvist cornering our allies tonight, Julian?"
"Let her play Article IX—we survive tonight and her quiver is empty."

passiveDomainCheck.insight: Invoking Article IX spends Lindqvist's final procedural trump card before the Finale.

n2_a.speaker: vance
n2_a.tellCaption: Vance's voice is taut with quiet gravity.
n2_a.text: I knew she would strike before open water. Win on the sky-bridge, and she has zero legal moves left.

n2_b.speaker: vance
n2_b.tellCaption: A faint note of admiration warms Vance's baritone.
n2_b.text: Spoken like a grandmaster who sees two moves past the sacrifice.

n3.speaker: tariq
n3.tellCaption: Tariq leans toward the glowing screen.
n3.text: Whatever happens tomorrow at the Apex, Julian—thank you for Hangar Four.

choices.label: "Tomorrow we finish your seven-year game in broad daylight."
"Sentiments tonight—zero mercy across the Prism tomorrow, Julian."

n4_close.speaker: vance
n4_close.tellCaption: Vance taps his silver stylus twice beside his ear before disconnecting.
n4_close.text: I would accept nothing less from my successor.

n1.speaker: nadia
n1.tellCaption: Red threads stretch across a glass wall map linking Geneva, London, Tokyo, Rio, Cairo, and Reykjavik.
n1.text: Every piece of the Dossier is on the glass. Twelve clues, six capitals, zero gaps left.

choices.label: "If we win the Master Key, Charter Footnote 44 lets us share it."
"Or one incorruptible Arbiter holds the line between all three blocs."

passiveDomainCheck.insight: Complete evidentiary chains prevent post-broadcast constitutional challenges.

n2_a.speaker: teo
n2_a.tellCaption: Teo grins, tapping Footnote 44 on the glass.
n2_a.text: Dissolving the lone throne live in front of two billion people? Greatest broadcast moment in human history.

n2_b.speaker: soren
n2_b.tellCaption: Soren nods thoughtfully, rolling his coin slow.
n2_b.text: A strong referee keeps three sharks honest—as long as the referee never sells out.

n3.speaker: nadia
n3.tellCaption: Helicopter strobes sweep across the penthouse ceiling from the bay pad.
n3.text: Our ride to International Waters just landed. Ready to meet destiny?

choices.label: "Together—every step onto that ocean stage."
"Keep the relays locked—I will handle Julian Vance."

n4_close.speaker: teo
n4_close.tellCaption: Teo slings his camera pack over one shoulder.
n4_close.text: Next stop: Point Nemo's twin—and two billion pairs of eyes.

n1.speaker: vance
n1.tellCaption: Ocean spray mists the towering curved glass behind two billion live viewers.
n1.text: Phase One: Gauntlet Shield Break. Prove your speed matches your conviction before the entire planet.

n2.speaker: vance
n2.tellCaption: The Master Ledger Core rises from the marble floor on twin brass gimbals.
n2.text: Phase Two: Master Ledger Synthesis. Three interlocking historical and scientific truths—one single key.

n3.speaker: vance
n3.tellCaption: Julian Vance unbuttons his midnight-indigo jacket and sits directly across from you.
n3.text: Final Phase: Sovereign Sudden Death. No shields, no redactions—just your mind against the architect of the Meridian.

choices.label: "From Geneva to the ocean—let's finish your masterpiece, Julian."
Keep your eyes locked on his left brass cufflink for the final bluff

backstage_conversations.title: Passing the Torch Live on Air
backstage_conversations.locationLabel: Master Ledger Core · The Apex Forum

n1.speaker: lindqvist
n1.tellCaption: Up in the diplomatic tier, Chancellor Lindqvist slams the emergency cutoff console.
n1.text: Cut the satellite uplink! Do not let them unlock the Master Ledger on an open broadcast!

n2.speaker: tariq
n2.tellCaption: Every screen around the ocean amphitheater blazes gold—locked open worldwide.
n2.text: Too late, Chancellor! Teo and I hard-locked every relay from Reykjavik to Tokyo—the whole world is watching!

n3.speaker: vance
n3.tellCaption: Julian Vance steps back from the illuminated Prism and bows his head in quiet pride.
n3.text: Seven years of shadow end tonight. The Veritas Prism is yours, Challenger. Make your final decree.

choices.label: Place your hand on the Master Ledger Core to choose humanity's future

n1.speaker: nadia
n1.tellCaption: Ocean swells boom softly against titanium hull plates as Nadia, Soren, Teo, and Tariq gather round.
n1.text: Listen to that roar above deck. Two billion people tuned in from every time zone on Earth.

choices.label: "None of my reads would be sharp enough tonight without facing you all first."
"Quick—give me one last scouting note on Julian Vance's tells."

passiveDomainCheck.insight: Simultaneous six-continent broadcasts unite roughly one-quarter of humanity in real time.

n2_a.speaker: soren
n2_a.tellCaption: Soren presses his lucky hollow coin briefly into your palm, then takes it back.
n2_a.text: Hey—if anyone was going to bust my streak in Tokyo and Singapore, glad it was the future Champ.

n2_b.speaker: tariq
n2_b.text: Watch his silver stylus, not his cufflink. Tonight Julian has zero secrets left to hide—every wager he makes is real.

n3.speaker: teo
n3.tellCaption: Stage call chimes three resonant gold notes across the intercom.
n3.text: Thirty seconds to air! All six continental relays green and unbreakable!

choices.label: Share one quiet breath with your circle before stepping into the lights
Square your shoulders and stride calmly toward the Grand Dais
